title: View Transition
description: The browser's View Transitions API, made safe to reach for: a card grows into its detail page, a list reorders in place, and a page change cross-fades instead of blinking. Interlace adds only what the API leaves to every app: a fallback where it is…
author: ofri-peretz <https://github.com/ofri-peretz>
docs:
## @interlace/view-transition

Installed to `components/ui/effects/view-transition.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/effects/view-transition';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/view-transition

Requires the `@interlace/interlace-base` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency). For the Interlace look, also add `@interlace/theme`.
